Give it everything we've got!|audio = Moltenwave-30.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 30 (Formerly, [[Molten Mode|Molten]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Molten Executioner''' is a mini boss that appears in [[Molten Mode|Molten Mode]] on Wave 30. It also appears on Wave 20 of [[The Takeover Event]]. It has a high amount of health but it walks slowly. It has [[Health Regen]], which causes it to regenerate 2% of its health every 2 seconds. It has a single ability, ''Execution Day'', where it targets one tower and slams it with its hammer, stunning it for 8 seconds. ==Appearance== The '''Molten Executioner''' is an enemy that has had most of its body replaced with mechanical parts, with only some remnants of its red skin covering it. It has a grey mechanical body with multiple neon orange lights, some of which are on tubes. Its head is replaced with a mechanical skull that has teeth and two neon orange eyes. It has a large core in its torso. Multiple neon orange veins appear on its body. It wields a grey hammer with tubes at the back which is also covered in flesh. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, such as the [[Minigunner]], [[Ranger]], [[Crook Boss]] and [[Hunter]] are recommended to take this enemy down. **The [[DJ Booth]] and [[Commander]] can be used to boost these towers. *The [[Medic]] can be used to shield towers, preventing them from being stunned by '''Molten Executioner's''' ''Execution Day''. **Towers with [[Stun Immunity]], like the [[Pursuit]] or [[Ranger]], can be used so that the '''Molten Executioner''' cannot stun your towers. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1MoltenExe.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseMoltenExe.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Valentines Skins - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Molten Executioner''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexMoltenExecutioner.png|'''Molten Executioner''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- !
